0.en: C. Individuality That Is Real in and for Itself
0.zh: C. 自在自为地实在的个体性

en: Self-consciousness has now grasped the concept of itself that at first was only ours of it, namely to be all reality in the certainty of itself, and purpose and essence is for it now the self-moving interpenetration of the universal – of the gifts and capacities – and of individuality.
– The single moments of this fulfillment and interpenetration, before the unity into which they have come together, are the purposes considered so far.

They have vanished as abstractions and chimeras that belong to those first insipid shapes of spiritual self-consciousness and have their truth only in the meant being of the heart, of the imagination and of talk, not in reason, which now, certain in and for itself of its reality, no longer seeks to bring itself forth as a purpose in opposition to immediately existing actuality, but has the category as such for the object of its consciousness.

– Namely, the determination of self-consciousness as being-for-itself or negative, in which reason appeared, is sublated; it found an actuality present before it that would be the negative of itself, and only through the sublation of that actuality did it actualize its purpose.

But since purpose and being-in-itself have turned out to be the same as what being-for-another and the actuality found before it is, truth no longer separates itself from certainty – whether the posited purpose is taken for the certainty of itself and its realization for the truth, or else the purpose for the truth and the actuality for the certainty –, but the essence and the purpose in and for itself is the certainty of immediate reality itself, the interpenetration of being-in-itself and being-for-itself, of the universal and of individuality; the doing is in itself its truth and actuality, and the presentation or the utterance of individuality is for it purpose in and for itself.
zh: 自我意识现在已经把握住了关于它自己的概念，这个概念起初还只是我们关于它的概念，即：在自己的确定性中就是一切实在性，而现在，对它来说，目的和本质就是那自身运动着的、普遍的东西——即天赋和能力——与个体性的相互渗透。
——这种充实和相互渗透在它们已经走入的那个统一之前的各个单一环节，就是迄今为止所考察的那些目的。
它们已经作为抽象物和妄想消失了，这些抽象物和妄想属于精神性自我意识那些最初的乏味形态，它们的真理只存在于心的、想象和言谈的被意谓的存在中，而不存在于理性之中，理性现在已经自在自为地确信自己的实在性，不再力求作为与直接存在着的现实性相对立的目的而把自己产生出来，而是把范畴本身当作自己意识的对象。
——也就是说，理性当初在其中出现的那种自为存在着的、或者说否定的自我意识的规定性被扬弃了；它曾发现一种现成存在的现实性，这种现实性会是它的否定面，而只有通过扬弃这种现实性，它才实现自己的目的。

但是，既然目的和自在存在已经表明自己就是为他存在和所遇到的现实性所是的东西，那么真理就不再与确定性分离开来——不论是把被设定的目的算作对自己的确定性、把目的的实现算作真理，还是把目的算作真理、把现实性算作确定性——，而是说，自在自为的本质和目的就是直接实在性本身的确定性，就是自在存在与自为存在、普遍的东西与个体性的相互渗透；行动在它自身那里就是它的真理和现实性，而个体性的展示或道出对它说来就是自在自为的目的。

en: With this concept, then, self-consciousness has withdrawn into itself out of the opposed determinations that the category had for it as observing and then as acting and for its comportment toward the category.
It has the pure category itself as its object, or it is the category that has become conscious of itself.

The account with its previous shapes is thereby settled; they lie behind it in oblivion, do not come to stand over against it as its found world, but develop only within it itself as transparent moments.
Yet they still come apart in its consciousness as a movement of distinguished moments that has not yet gathered itself into their substantial unity.
But in all of them it holds fast the simple unity of being and of the self, which is their genus.
zh: 因此，随着这个概念，自我意识就从那些对立的规定中返回到自身之内了，这些规定是范畴对作为观察着的、随后又作为行动着的它以及它对范畴的态度所具有的。
它把纯粹范畴本身当作自己的对象，或者说，它就是那已经意识到自身的范畴。
这样一来，它与先前那些形态的账就算清了；这些形态落在它身后，被遗忘，不再作为它现成的世界与它相对而立，而只是在它自身之内作为透明的环节展开。
不过，它们在它的意识中还是作为一些有区别的环节的运动而分散开来，这个运动还没有把自己收拢为它们的实体性的统一。
但在所有这些环节之中，它都牢牢把握着存在与自我的单纯统一，这种统一就是它们的类。

en: Consciousness has hereby thrown off all opposition and every condition of its doing; it proceeds freshly from itself, and not toward an other but toward itself.
Since individuality is actuality on itself, the material of the effecting and the purpose of the doing lie in the doing itself.

The doing therefore has the appearance of the movement of a circle that moves freely in the void within itself, unhindered now expands, now contracts, and, perfectly content, plays only in and with itself.
The element in which individuality presents its shape has the meaning of a pure reception of this shape; it is the day in general, to which consciousness wants to show itself.

The doing changes nothing and goes against nothing; it is the pure form of translation from being-unseen into being-seen, and the content that is brought to day and presents itself is nothing other than what this doing already is in itself.

It is in itself: this is its form as thought unity; and it is actual: this is its form as existing unity; it itself is content only in this determination of simplicity as against the determination of its transition and its movement.
zh: 意识由此抛掉了自己行动的一切对立和一切条件；它轻快地从自身出发，而且不是走向另一个东西，而是走向自己。
既然个体性在它自身那里就是现实性，那么作用的材料和行动的目的就在行动本身之中。
所以，行动具有一个圆的运动的外观，这个圆自由地在虚空中运动于自身之内，不受阻碍地时而扩大、时而缩小，并且十分满足地只在自身之中、只与自身玩耍。
个体性在其中展示自己形态的那个要素，具有纯粹接受这一形态的意义；它就是一般而言的白昼，意识想要在它面前显现自己。
行动不改变什么，也不针对什么；它是从不被看见向被看见转换的纯粹形式，而那被带到白昼上来并展示自己的内容，不是别的，正是这一行动已经自在地是的东西。
它是自在的：这是它作为被思维的统一的形式；而它是现实的：这是它作为存在着的统一的形式，它自己只有在与它的过渡和它的运动的规定相对立的这种单纯性的规定中才是内容。

4.en: a. The Spiritual Animal Kingdom and Deceit, or the Matter Itself
4.zh: a. 精神动物王国与欺骗，或事情本身

en: This individuality that is real in itself is at first again a single and determinate one; the absolute reality, as which it knows itself, is therefore, as it becomes conscious of that reality, the abstract universal, which, without fulfillment and content, is only the empty thought of this category.
– It is to be seen how this concept of individuality real in itself determines itself in its moments, and how its concept of itself enters into its consciousness.
zh: 这种自在的实在个体性，起初又是个别的、被规定了的；因此，那种它知道自己所是的绝对实在性，正如它意识到这种实在性那样，就是抽象的、普遍的东西，这种东西没有充实和内容，只是这一范畴的空洞思想。
——必须看一看，这种自在的实在个体性的概念如何在它的各个环节中规定自身，以及它关于它自己的概念如何进入它的意识。

en: The concept of this individuality, as it as such is for itself all reality, is at first result; it has not yet presented its movement and reality, and is here immediately posited as simple being-in-itself.
But the negativity, which is the same as what appears as movement, is on the simple in-itself as determinacy; and the being or the simple in-itself becomes a determinate compass.

Individuality therefore appears as originally determinate nature: as original nature, because it is in itself, – as originally determinate, because the negative is on the in-itself, and this is thereby a quality.

However, this limitation of being cannot limit the doing of consciousness, for this is here a completed relating of oneself to oneself; the relation to an other is sublated, which would be the limitation of that doing.

The original determinacy of nature is therefore only a simple principle, – a transparent universal element in which individuality remains just as free and equal to itself as it there unfolds its differences unhindered and is pure reciprocal interaction with itself in its actualization.

As the indeterminate animal life breathes its breath into the element of water, air or earth and, within these, again into more determinate principles, immerses all its moments in them, yet notwithstanding that limitation of the element keeps them in its power and itself in its one, and as this particular organization remains the same universal animal life.
zh: 这种个体性的概念，就它作为这样的个体性而自为地是一切实在性而言，起初是结果；它还没有展示自己的运动和实在性，在这里被直接设定为单纯的自在存在。
但是，那种与作为运动而出现的东西是同一个东西的否定性，在单纯的自在那里就是规定性；而存在或单纯的自在则成为一个被规定了的范围。
所以，个体性作为原初被规定的自然出现：作为原初的自然，因为它是自在的，——作为原初被规定的自然，因为否定的东西就在自在那里，而自在由此就是一种质。
然而，存在的这种限制不能限制意识的行动，因为这种行动在这里是一种完成了的对自身的关涉；对另一个东西的关系被扬弃了，而这种关系本会是它的限制。
所以，自然的原初规定性只是单纯的原则，——一个透明的、普遍的要素，个体性在其中既保持自由、保持与自身相同一，又不受阻碍地在其中展开自己的各种差别，并在自己的实现中与自身处于纯粹的相互作用之中。
正如那不确定的动物生命把它的气息吹入水、空气或土的要素之中，并在这些要素之内又吹入更被规定的原则之中，把自己的全部环节都浸入其中，但尽管有要素的那种限制，它仍然把这些环节保持在自己的力量之下、把自己保持在它的一里，并且作为这种特殊的组织而依然是同一个普遍的动物生命。

en: This determinate original nature of consciousness that remains free and whole in it appears as the immediate and only proper content of what is purpose for the individual; it is indeed determinate content, but it is content at all only insofar as we consider being-in-itself in isolation; in truth, however, it is the reality penetrated by individuality, the actuality as consciousness as a single one has it on itself and is at first posited as existing, not yet as acting.

But for the doing, on the one hand, that determinacy is for that reason not a limitation beyond which it would want to go, because, considered as existing quality, it is the simple color of the element in which it moves; on the other hand, however, negativity is determinacy only on being; but the doing is itself nothing other than negativity; on the acting individuality, therefore, determinacy is dissolved into negativity in general, or the sum-total of all determinacy.
zh: 在它之中保持自由和完整的意识的这种被规定的原初自然，作为对个体来说是目的的那种东西的直接而唯一真正的内容而出现；它固然是被规定的内容，但只有当我们把自在存在孤立起来考察时，它才一般地是内容；而它在真理中却是被个体性渗透了的实在性，是意识作为个别的东西在它自身那里所具有、并且最初被设定为存在着的、而不是行动着的现实性。
但对行动来说，一方面，那种规定性之所以不是它想要越出的限制，是因为它作为存在着的质来看是行动在其中运动的那个要素的单纯颜色；另一方面，否定性只是在存在那里才是规定性；而行动本身不是别的，正是否定性；所以在行动着的个体性那里，规定性已经消解为一般的否定性，即一切规定性的总括。

en: The simple original nature now enters, in the act and in the consciousness of the act, into the difference that belongs to this consciousness of the act.
It is present first as object, and indeed as object insofar as it still belongs to consciousness, as purpose, and thus as opposed to an existing actuality.

The other moment is the movement of the purpose represented as resting, the realization, as the relation of the purpose to the wholly formal actuality, hence the representation of the transition itself, or the means.
The third is finally the object as it is no longer the purpose of which the doer is immediately conscious as its own, but as it has come out of it and is for it as an other.

– But these different sides are now, according to the concept of this sphere, to be held fast in such a way that the content remains the same in them and no difference enters in, neither of individuality and of being in general, nor of the purpose as against individuality as original nature, nor as against the existing actuality, nor likewise of the means as against it as absolute purpose, nor of the effected actuality as against the purpose or the original nature or the means.
zh: 现在，那单纯的原始自然在行动中、在对行动的意识中，进入了属于这种对行动的意识的那种差别。
它首先作为对象而存在，而且是作为还属于意识的对象、作为目的而存在，并因此与一种现成的现实性相对立。
另一个环节是被表象为静止的目的的运动，即实现，作为目的与完全形式的现实性的关系，因而也就是过渡本身的表象，或者说手段。
第三个最后是对象，这时它不再是那种行动者直接意识到是自己的东西的目的，而是它已经从目的中出来、并且对它来说作为他物而存在。
——但是，按照这一领域的概念，这些不同的方面现在必须这样牢牢把握住：内容在它们那里保持为同一个内容，并没有任何差别进来，既不是个体性与存在一般的差别，也不是目的与作为原始自然的个体性的差别，也不是目的与现成现实性的差别，同样也不是手段与作为绝对目的的个体性的差别，也不是被造成的现实性与目的、或与原始自然、或与手段的差别。

en: First, then, the originally determinate nature of individuality, its immediate essence, is not yet posited as doing, and is accordingly called particular capacity, talent, character, etc.
This peculiar tincture of spirit is to be regarded as the sole content of the purpose itself and quite alone as the reality.
If one represented consciousness to oneself as going beyond it and as wanting to bring another content to actuality, then one represented it as a nothing working away into the nothing.

– Further, this original essence is not only the content of the purpose, but in itself also the actuality that otherwise appears as the given material of the doing, as the actuality that is found ready to hand and is to be formed in the doing.

For the doing is only a pure translating out of the form of being-not-yet-exhibited into that of exhibited being; the being-in-itself of that actuality opposed to consciousness has sunk down to a mere empty semblance.

This consciousness, in determining itself to action, therefore does not let itself be led astray by the semblance of the existing actuality, and likewise it has to hold itself together, away from the wandering about in empty thoughts and purposes, upon the original content of its essence.

– To be sure, this original content is [a content] for consciousness only once it has actualized it; but the difference between something that is for consciousness only within it and an actuality that is in itself outside it has fallen away.
Only in order that what it is in itself may be for it, it must act; or acting is precisely the becoming of spirit as consciousness.
What it is in itself, it therefore knows from its actuality.
The individual therefore cannot know what it is before it has brought itself to actuality through doing.

– But it thereby seems unable to determine the purpose of its doing before it has done it; yet at the same time, since it is consciousness, it must beforehand have the action before itself as wholly its own, i.e. as purpose.

The individual that proceeds to act thus seems to find itself in a circle in which each moment already presupposes the other, and thus to be unable to find any beginning, because it first comes to know its original essence, which must be its purpose, from the deed, but in order to do must beforehand have the purpose.

But just for that reason it has to begin immediately and, whatever the circumstances, to proceed to activity without further pondering about beginning, means and end; for its essence and in-itself-existing nature is everything at once: beginning, means and end.
As beginning, it is present in the circumstances of action, and the interest that the individual finds in something is the already given answer to the question whether and what is to be done here.

For what seems to be an existing actuality is in itself its original nature, which has only the semblance of a being — a semblance that lies in the concept of the self-dirempting doing, but as its original nature expresses itself in the interest that it finds in it.
– Likewise the how, or the means, is determined in and for itself.
Talent is likewise nothing other than the determinate original individuality, considered as the inner means or transition of the purpose to actuality.

But the actual means and the real transition is the unity of talent and of the nature of the matter present in the interest; the former exhibits in the means the side of the doing, the latter the side of the content; both are individuality itself, as the interpenetration of being and doing.

What is thus present is: circumstances found ready to hand, which in themselves are the original nature of the individual; then the interest, which posits them precisely as its own or as purpose; finally the connecting and sublating of this opposition in the means.
This connecting still falls within consciousness itself, and the whole just considered is the one side of an opposition.

This semblance of opposition still remaining is sublated by the transition itself, or the means — for it is the unity of the outer and the inner, the opposite of the determinacy that it has as inner means; it thus sublates this determinacy and posits itself, this unity of doing and being, likewise as outer, as individuality itself that has become actual, i.e. that which is posited for itself as the existent.
In this way the whole action neither emerges from itself as the circumstances, nor as purpose nor means, nor as the work.
zh: 首先，个体性那原初被规定的自然、它的直接本质，还没有被设定为行动着的，因此就叫做特殊的能力、天赋、性格等等。
这种精神特有的色调，必须被看作目的本身唯一的内容，并且完全只被看作实在性。
如果人们把意识表象为超出了它、并且想把另一种内容带向现实性，那么人们就是把意识表象为一个朝着无而劳作着的无。
——此外，这个原始本质不仅是目的的内容，而且自在地也是那种现实性，这种现实性在其他情况下表现为行动被给予的材料，表现为现成的、并且要在行动中得到形成的现实性。
因为行动只是一种纯粹的转译，从还没有被展示出来的存在形式转译到被展示出来的存在形式；那种与意识相对立的现实性的自在存在，已经下降为纯粹空洞的假象。
这种意识在把自己规定为行动时，就不会被现成现实性的假象弄乱，同样，它也必须把自己从在空洞的思想和目的中的四处游荡收拢到它本质的原始内容上。
——这个原始内容固然只有在意识已经把它实现出来之后才为意识而存在；但是，那种只在意识之内的东西与一种在意识之外自在地存在着的现实性之间的差别，已经消失了。
只是为了让它自在地所是的东西成为为它的东西，它就必须行动；或者说，行动正是精神作为意识的生成。
所以，它自在地是什么，它是从自己的现实性中知道的。
所以，个体在通过行动把自己带到现实性之前，不能知道自己是什么。
——但这样一来，它似乎就不能在行动之前规定自己行动的目的；然而同时，由于它是意识，它就必须事先把行动作为完全属于自己的行动、也就是作为目的而摆在面前。
所以，那个走向行动的个体似乎处在一个圆圈里，其中每个环节都已经以另一个环节为前提，因而它似乎找不到开端，因为它必须从行为中才认识到自己的原始本质——而这本质必须是它的目的——可是为了行动，它又必须事先拥有目的。
但正因如此，它必须直接开始，并且，无论处在什么情况下，都要不进一步顾虑开端、手段和终点，就走向活动；因为它的本质和自在存在着的自然同时就是一切：开端、手段和终点。
作为开端，它现成地存在于行动的各种情况中，而个体对某物感到的兴趣，就是对“在这里是否要做、要做什么”这个问题的已经给出的回答。
因为看起来是现成现实性的东西，自在地就是它原始的自然，这自然只有存在的假象——一个包含在自我分裂的行动这个概念里的假象，但它作为它原始的自然，却是在它对之感到的兴趣中表达出来的。
——同样，“如何”或者说手段，是自在自为地被规定的。
天赋同样不是别的什么，就是那被规定的原始个体性，被看作内在的手段，或者说目的向现实性的过渡。
但现实的手段和实在的过渡，是天赋与在兴趣中现成存在的、事情之自然的统一；前者在手段上代表着行动的一面，后者代表着内容的一面，两者都是个体性本身，作为存在与行动的相互渗透。
所以，现成存在的东西是：现成已有的各种情况，它们自在地就是个体原始的自然；然后是兴趣，它恰恰把这些情况设定为自己的东西，或者设定为目的；最后是在手段中对这一对立的联结和扬弃。
这种联结本身还落在意识之内，而刚才考察的整体是对立的一面。
这种还余留下来的对立的假象，被过渡本身或者说手段所扬弃——因为手段是外在东西与内在东西的统一，是它作为内在手段所具有的那种规定性的反面；所以手段扬弃了这种规定性，并把自己、把这种行动与存在的统一，同样设定为外在的东西，设定为已经变成现实的个体性本身，也就是说，设定为那个对自身来说被设定为存在者的东西。
这样，整个行动既不是作为情况、也不是作为目的、也不是作为手段、也不是作为作品而从自身中走出来的。

en: With the work, however, the difference of the original natures seems to enter; the work is, like the original nature it expresses, something determinate; for, released freely from the activity as existent actuality, negativity is upon it as quality.

But consciousness determines itself over against it as that which has determinacy as negativity in general, as activity, upon itself; it is therefore the universal as against that determinacy of the work, can therefore compare it with others and from this grasp the individualities themselves as different; the individual that reaches further beyond itself in its work either as a stronger energy of the will or as a richer nature, i.e. one whose original determinacy is less limited — another, by contrast, as a weaker and more meager nature.
In contrast to this unessential difference of magnitude, good and bad would express an absolute difference; but here the latter does not occur.

Whatever might be taken in one way or the other is in the same way an activity and a busy-ness, a presenting and expressing of an individuality, and therefore all good; and it would really not be possible to say what the bad should be.

What would be called a bad work is the individual life of a determinate nature that actualizes itself in it; it would be corrupted into a bad work only by comparative thought, which however is something empty, since it goes beyond the essence of the work, which is to be a self-expressing of individuality, and otherwise seeks and demands in it something — one does not know what.

– It could only concern the difference cited above; but this is in itself, as a difference of magnitude, an unessential one, and is here determinate because it would be different works or individualities that were compared with one another; but these have nothing to do with each other; each relates only to itself.

The original nature is alone the in-itself, or that which could be laid down as the standard for judging the work, and conversely; but the two correspond to each other: there is nothing for individuality that is not through it, or there is no actuality that is not its nature and its activity, and no activity nor in-itself of the same that is not actual, and only these moments are to be compared.
zh: 但随作品一起，那些原初本性的差别似乎就出现了；作品像它所表达的原初本性一样，是一个被规定的东西，因为否定性作为存在着的现实性从行动中被自由地释放出来，就作为质而附着在它身上。
但意识则把自己规定为与作品相对的那一方，即在自己身上拥有规定性——作为一般的否定性、作为行动——的那一方；所以它是相对于作品那种规定性而言的普遍者，因而能把作品与别的作品加以比较，并由此把诸个体性本身把握为不同的：在自己的作品中进一步越出自身的个体，要么是意志的更强大的能量，要么是更丰富的本性，也就是说，它的原初规定性较少受到限制——而另一个个体则是一种更弱、更贫乏的本性。
相对于这种非本质的大小差别，好与坏会表达出一种绝对差别；但在这里，这种绝对差别并不出现。
无论以这种或那种方式来看待，它都同样是一种行动与忙活，是一个个体性的展示和表达，因此一切都是好的；而且本来就说不出坏应当是什么。
一件被称作坏的作品，是一个特定本性的个体性生活，这个本性在其中把自己现实化；它只有通过比较性的思想才会被弄坏成一件坏作品，而这种思想是某种空洞的东西，因为它超出了作品的本质——作品是个体性的一种自我表达——并且此外还在作品上寻找和要求某种谁也不知道是什么的东西。
——它只能涉及前面提到的那种差别；但这种差别自在地、作为大小上的差别，是非本质的，而且它在这里之所以是被规定了的，是因为被相互比较的会是不同的作品或个体性；但这些作品或个体性彼此毫不相干；每一个都只与自身相关。
原初本性单独就是自在，或者就是那个能够被当作评判作品的尺度、并且反过来也能被当作尺度的东西；但两者彼此相合：对个体性来说，没有什么东西不是通过它而有的，或者说，没有任何现实性不是它的本性和它的行动，也没有它的任何行动或自在不是现实的，而只有这些环节才是可以比较的。

en: Hence there occurs in general neither exaltation, nor complaint, nor remorse; for all such things come from thought, which imagines for itself another content and another in-itself than the original nature of the individual and its execution as present in actuality is.

Whatever it is that it does and that happens to it, this it has done and is itself; it can only have the consciousness of the pure translating of itself out of the night of possibility into the day of the present, of the abstract in-itself into the meaning of actual being, and the certainty that what comes to it in this is nothing other than what slept in that.

The consciousness of this unity is indeed likewise a comparison, but what is compared has precisely only the semblance of opposition; a semblance of form, which for the self-consciousness of reason — that individuality is in itself actuality — is nothing more than semblance.

The individual can therefore, since it knows that in its actuality it can find nothing other than its unity with it, or only the certainty of itself in its truth, and that it therefore always reaches its purpose, experience only joy in itself.
zh: 因此，一般说来既没有振奋，也没有抱怨，也没有悔恨；因为诸如此类的东西都来自思想，这种思想给自己想象出另一种内容和另一种自在，不同于个体的原初本性以及它在现实性中已有的实行。
无论它做什么、无论它遭遇什么，这都是它做过的，并且就是它自己；它只能拥有对自身之纯粹翻译的意识——从可能性的黑夜翻译到当下的白天，从抽象的自在翻译到现实的存在所具有的意义——并且拥有这样的确定性：在这个白天里向它出现的东西，不是别的，正是在那个黑夜里沉睡的东西。
对这种统一的意识虽然同样是一种比较，但被比较的东西恰恰只具有对立的假象；这是形式上的假象，而对理性的自我意识——即对个体性在它自身那里就是现实性这一点——来说，它只不过是假象。
所以，个体既然知道自己在其现实性中只能找到它与自己的统一，或只是自己在其真理中的确定性，并且知道自己因此总是达到自己的目的，它就只能在自身那里体验到喜悦。

en: This is the concept that consciousness, certain of itself as the absolute interpenetration of individuality and being, makes of itself; let us see whether it is confirmed to it through experience and whether its reality corresponds to it.

The work is the reality that consciousness gives itself; it is that in which the individual is for consciousness what it is in itself, and in such a way that the consciousness for which it becomes in the work is not the particular but the universal consciousness; in the work it has in general placed itself out into the element of universality, into the determinacy-less space of being.

The consciousness that steps back from its work is in fact the universal — because it becomes the absolute negativity or the activity in this opposition — as against its work, which is the determinate; it therefore goes beyond itself as work and is itself the determinacy-less space that does not find itself filled by its work.
If previously their unity was still preserved in the concept, this happened precisely because the work was sublated as existent work.
But it is supposed to be, and we are to see how in its being individuality will preserve its universality and will know how to satisfy itself.
– First, the work that has come to be is to be considered for itself.

It has received along with it the whole nature of individuality; its being is therefore itself an activity in which all differences interpenetrate and dissolve; the work is thus thrown out into a subsistence in which the determinacy of the original nature in fact turns outward against other determinate natures, intrudes into them as these others into it, and loses itself as a vanishing moment in this universal movement.

If within the concept of individuality that is real in and for itself all moments, circumstances, purpose, means, and the actualization are equal to one another and the original determinate nature counts only as a universal element, then on the other hand, in that this element becomes objective being, its determinacy as such comes to light in the work and receives its truth in its dissolution.

More closely, this dissolution presents itself thus: that in this determinacy the individual as this one has become actual; but it is not only content of actuality, but equally form of the same, or actuality as such in general is precisely this determinacy, to be opposed to self-consciousness.
From this side it shows itself as the foreign actuality that has vanished out of the concept, merely found there.

The work is, i.e. it is for other individualities, and for them a foreign actuality, in whose place they must put their own in order through their activity to give themselves the consciousness of their unity with actuality; or their interest in that work, posited by their original nature, is another than the peculiar interest of this work, which is thereby made into something else.

The work is therefore in general something perishable, which is extinguished through the interplay of other forces and interests, and represents the reality of individuality far more as vanishing than as accomplished.
zh: 这就是意识对自己所形成的概念，这意识确信自己是个体性与存在的绝对渗透；让我们看看，这个概念是否通过经验向它得到证实，它的实在性是否与之相合。
作品是意识给予自己的实在性；它是这样一种东西：在其中，个体对意识来说就是它自在地所是的东西，而且是这样的，即那个意识——个体在作品中是为它而形成的——不是特殊的意识，而是普遍的意识；它在作品中一般已把自己置出到普遍性的要素中，置出到存在那个无规定性的空间里。
从自己的作品那里退回的意识，事实上就是那个普遍者——因为它在这种对立中成了绝对的否定性或行动——它相对于自己的作品，而作品是被规定的东西；所以它超出了作为作品的自己，并且本身就是那个无规定性的空间，它发现自己并没有被自己的作品所充实。
如果说刚才在概念中两者的统一毕竟还保持着，那么这恰恰是因为作品作为存在着的作品被扬弃了。
但作品应当存在，而要看看的是：在它的存在中，个体性将如何保持自己的普遍性，并将懂得如何使自己得到满足。
——首先，要自为地考察那已经生成的作品。
它一起领受了全部个体性本性；因此它的存在本身就是一种行动，在其中一切差别相互渗透并消解；所以作品被抛入一种持续存在之中，在其中，原初本性的规定性事实上向外翻转向其他特定的本性，侵入它们，正如这些其他本性侵入它一样，并且在这种普遍的运动中作为一个消逝着的环节而消失。
如果说在自在自为地实在的个体性这个概念内部，一切环节、情况、目的、手段以及现实化都彼此相同，而原初的特定本性只被当作普遍的元素，那么反过来，当这个元素成为对象性的存在时，它的规定性本身就在作品中显露出来，并在自己的消解中获得自己的真理。
更切近地说，这种消解是这样呈现的：在这种规定性中，个体作为这一个已成为现实的；但这种规定性不只是现实性的内容，同样也是现实性的形式，或者说，现实性本身一般就是这种规定性：与自我意识相对立。
从这一方面看，它表现为那种从概念中消失了的、仅仅现成遇到的陌生现实性。
作品存在着，也就是说，它对其他个体性来说存在，而对它们来说是一种陌生的现实性，它们必须用自己的现实性去取代它，以便通过自己的行动给自己提供自己与现实的统一这一意识；或者，它们由自己的原初本性所设定的对那件作品的兴趣，不同于这件作品固有的兴趣，而作品由此被弄成了另一种东西。
所以作品一般说来是某种易逝的东西，它通过其他诸力和其他兴趣的交互作用而被抹掉，并且把个体性的实在性更多地表现为消逝着的，而不是表现为完成了的。

en: Thus there arises for consciousness in its work the opposition of activity and being, which in the earlier shapes of consciousness was at the same time the beginning of the activity, [but] here is only result.

But in fact it likewise lay at the basis, in that consciousness went to acting as individuality that is real in itself; for for acting, the determinate original nature was presupposed as the in-itself, and pure accomplishing for the sake of accomplishing had it as its content.
But pure activity is the form that is equal to itself, to which the determinacy of the original nature is therefore unequal.

Here as elsewhere it is indifferent which of the two is called concept and which reality; the original nature is the thought or the in-itself as against the activity, in which it first has its reality; or the original nature is the being both of individuality as such and of it as work, while the activity is the original concept as absolute transition or as becoming.

This inadequacy of the concept and of reality, which lies in its essence, consciousness experiences in its work; in this it therefore becomes for itself as it is in truth, and its empty concept of itself vanishes.
zh: 所以，在意识的作品中，对意识产生了行动与存在的对立，这种对立在意识的那些较早形态中同时是行动的开端，在这里却只是结果。
但它事实上同样早已是基础，因为意识是作为自在地实在的个体性去行事的；因为对行事来说，特定的原初本性已被预设为自在，而纯粹为了完成而完成，则以它为自己的内容。
但纯粹的行动是那自身等同的形式，而原初本性的规定性因此与这种形式不相等。
这里和别处一样，两者中哪一个被叫作概念、哪一个被叫作实在性，都无所谓；原初本性是被思考的东西或自在，与行动相对，而它只有在行动中才具有自己的实在性；或者，原初本性既是个体性本身的存在，也是它作为作品的存在，而行动则是原初的概念，作为绝对的过渡或作为生成。
概念与实在性的这种不相适合——它就在意识自己的本质里——是意识在自己的作品中经验到的；在作品中，意识因此对自己来说成为它在真理中所是的样子，而它关于自己的空洞概念也就消失了。

en: In this fundamental contradiction of the work, which is the truth of this individuality that is real in itself, all its sides therefore again come forth as contradictory; or the work, as the content of the whole individuality set out into being from the doing that is the negative unity and holds all moments captive, now lets them go free; and in the element of subsistence they become indifferent to one another.
Concept and reality thus separate as purpose and as that which is the original essential being.
It is contingent whether the purpose has genuine essential being, or whether the in-itself is made into the purpose.
Likewise concept and reality again fall apart as transition into actuality and as purpose; or it is contingent that the means expressing the purpose be chosen.

And finally, these inner moments taken together, whether they have a unity in themselves or not — the doing of the individual is again contingent as against actuality in general; luck decides just as much for a badly determined purpose and badly chosen means as against them.
zh: 在这个作品的根本矛盾中——作品是这种自在实在的个体性的真理——，个体性的所有方面于是又作为矛盾着的方面出现；或者说，作品作为整个个体性的内容，从那种是否定的统一、并把一切环节都拘禁起来的行动中被摆置到存在之中，现在就把它们释放出来；而在持存的要素里，它们彼此变得漠不相关。
于是，概念和实在性就作为目的、并作为那种原初的本质性的东西而彼此分离开来。
目的究竟具有真正的本质，还是自在被弄成目的，这是偶然的。
同样，概念和实在性又作为向现实性的过渡、并作为目的而分离开来；或者说，那个表达目的的手段是否被选中，这是偶然的。
最后，这些内在环节合在一起，无论它们自身是否具有统一，——个体的行动相对于一般现实性来说又成了偶然的；幸运既会决定赞成规定得很糟的目的和选择得很糟的手段，也同样会决定反对它们。

en: If, now, in its work, the opposition of willing and accomplishing, of purpose and means, and again of this inner element together with actuality itself, thereby comes to be for consciousness — an opposition that in general contains within itself the contingency of its doing —, then the unity and necessity of the same are likewise present; this side overreaches that one, and the experience of the contingency of doing is itself only a contingent experience.

The necessity of doing consists in this, that purpose is absolutely related to actuality, and this unity is the concept of doing; there is action, because doing is in and for itself the essence of actuality.

In the work there indeed emerges the contingency that being-accomplished has as against willing and accomplishing; and this experience, which seems bound to count as the truth, contradicts that concept of action.

If, however, we consider the content of this experience in its completeness, it is the vanishing work; what preserves itself is not the vanishing, but the vanishing is itself actual and tied to the work and itself vanishes along with it; the negative perishes together with the positive whose negation it is.
zh: 如果说这样一来，在意愿与完成、目的与手段、以及这个内在的东西连同现实性本身之间的对立，就此在意识的作品上为意识而出现——这种对立一般地在自己内包含着它的行动的偶然性——，那么同一个行动的统一和必然性也同样存在；这一方面压过那一方面，而关于行动的偶然性的经验本身也只是一次偶然的经验。
行动的必然性在于：目的绝对地与现实性相关，而这种统一就是行动的概念；之所以有行动，是因为行动自在自为地就是现实性的本质。
在作品中虽然出现了那种偶然性，即已经完成的存在相对于意愿与完成所具有的偶然性；而这种看起来必定要算作真理的经验，却与那个行动的概念相矛盾。
然而，如果我们完整地考察这种经验的内容，那么它就是正在消失的作品；保存下来的并不是消失，相反，消失本身是现实的，并且与作品系在一起，自己也随作品一同消失；否定的东西与那个以它为否定的肯定东西一起走向毁灭。

en: This vanishing of the vanishing lies in the concept of the individuality that is real in itself; for that in which the work, or what vanishes in it, vanishes, and which was to give to what has been called experience its supremacy over the concept that individuality has of itself, is objective actuality; but this is a moment that even in this consciousness itself no longer has any truth for itself; this truth consists only in the unity of this consciousness with the doing, and the true work is only that unity of doing and being, of willing and accomplishing.

For consciousness, therefore, on account of the certainty that underlies its action, the actuality opposed to it is itself something that is only for it; for it, as self-consciousness returned into itself, to which all opposition has vanished, that opposition can no longer come to be in this form of its being-for-itself over against actuality; rather, the opposition and the negativity that comes to appear on the work strikes herewith not only the content of the work or also of consciousness, but actuality as such, and thereby the opposition that is present only through it and on it, and the vanishing of the work.

In this way, then, consciousness reflects itself into itself out of its perishable work and asserts its concept and certainty as the persisting and abiding, against the experience of the contingency of doing; it in fact experiences its concept, in which actuality is only a moment, something for it, not the in-and-for-itself; it experiences it as a vanishing moment, and it therefore counts for it only as being in general, whose universality is the same as the doing.

This unity is the true work; it is the matter itself, which asserts itself absolutely and is experienced as the abiding, independently of the matter that is the contingency of individual doing as such, of circumstances, means and actuality.
zh: 这种消失的消失，就在自在实在的个体性这个概念本身之中；因为作品在其中消失、或者说在它身上消失着的东西在其中消失，并且它本来应当把一种凌驾于个体性对自身所具有的概念之上的优势赋予那被称为经验的东西，这个东西就是对象性的现实性；但现实性是一个环节，它即使在这种意识本身之中也不再自为地具有任何真理；这种真理只存在于这种意识与行动的统一之中，而真正的作品只是行动与存在、意愿与完成的那种统一。

因此，对意识来说，正因为它的行动所依据的那种确定性，那个与它相对立的现实性本身就是这样一种只对它而存在的东西；对作为返回自身之中的自我意识、即一切对立都已在其中消失的自我意识来说，这种对立再也不能以它这种自为存在的形式与现实性相对立；相反，在作品上显露出来的对立和否定性，这样一来就不只涉及作品的内容、或者也涉及意识的内容，而是涉及现实性本身，并因而涉及那种只有通过现实性、只有在现实性上才存在的对立，以及作品的消失。
这样一来，意识就从它那易逝的作品中反思到自身之中，并且针对关于行动之偶然性的经验，主张自己的概念和确定性是存在着的、持存着的东西；它事实上经验到自己的概念，在这个概念里，现实性只是一个环节，一个为它而存在的东西，而不是自在自为的东西；它把现实性经验为消失着的环节，因此现实性对它来说只算作一般存在，这种存在的普遍性与行动是同一个东西。
这种统一就是真正的作品；它就是事情本身，它绝对地主张自己，并且被经验为持存着的东西，不依赖于那样一种事情，即个体行动本身、处境、手段和现实性的偶然性。

en: The matter itself is opposed to these moments only insofar as they are supposed to count in isolation, but essentially, as the interpenetration of actuality and individuality, it is the unity of the two; equally a doing and, as doing, pure doing in general, hence equally the doing of this individual, and this doing, as still belonging to it, in opposition to actuality, as purpose; equally it is the transition out of this determinacy into the opposite one, and finally an actuality that is present for consciousness.

The matter itself hereby expresses the spiritual essence, in which all these moments are sublated as counting for themselves, thus count only as universal, and in which for consciousness its certainty of itself is objective essence, a matter; the object born out of self-consciousness as its own, without ceasing to be a free, proper object.
— The thing of sense-certainty and of perceiving now has its meaning for self-consciousness solely through it; on this rests the difference between a thing and a matter.
— A movement corresponding to sense-certainty and perception will be gone through on it.
zh: 事情本身只是在这些环节应当孤立地有效而言才与它们相对立，但本质上，作为现实性和个体性的相互渗透，它就是两者的统一；它同样是一种行动，并且作为行动是一般的纯粹行动，因此同样是这一个体的行动，而这种行动作为还属于它、并与现实性相对立的行动，则是目的；同样，它是从这种规定性向相反规定性的过渡，最后还是一种为意识而存在着的现实性。
事情本身由此表达出精神性的本质，在它里面，所有这些环节都作为自为地有效的东西被扬弃了，因而只作为普遍的东西而有效，并且在它里面，意识对自身的确定性成了对象性的本质，成了一种事情；这个对象是从自我意识中作为它自己的东西产生出来的，同时并没有停止成为自由的、本真的对象。
——感性确定性和知觉的物，现在对自我意识来说，其意义仅仅通过自我意识才具有；物和事情的差别就建立在这上面。
——在它上面将要走完一场与感性确定性和知觉相应的运动。

en: In the matter itself, therefore, as the interpenetration of individuality and objectivity that has become objective, self-consciousness has come to its true concept of itself, or it has come to the consciousness of its substance.

It is at the same time, as it is here, a consciousness of the substance that has only just come to be and is therefore immediate, and this is the determinate way in which the spiritual essence is here present and has not yet advanced to truly real substance.

In this immediate consciousness of the substance, the matter itself has the form of the simple essence, which as universal contains in itself all its different moments and belongs to them, but is also again indifferent towards them as determinate moments and free for itself, and counts as this free, simple, abstract matter itself, as the essence.

The various moments of the original determinacy, or of the matter of this individual — of its purpose, of the means, of the doing itself and of actuality — are for this consciousness on the one hand individual moments that it can leave behind and give up as against the matter itself; on the other hand, however, they all have the matter itself as essence only in such a way that, as the abstract universal of it, it is found on each of these different moments and can be a predicate of them.
It itself is not yet the subject; rather, those moments count in its place, because they fall on the side of singleness in general, while the matter itself is only at first the simply universal.
It is the genus that finds itself in all these moments as its species and is likewise free of them.
zh: 所以，在事情本身中，也就是在个体性和对象性本身已经变成对象性的那种相互渗透中，自我意识已经形成了关于自身的真正概念，或者说，它已经达到了对其实体的意识。
它同时——正如它在这里的样子——是一种刚刚形成的、因而直接的关于实体的意识，而这就是精神性的本质在这里存在、并且还没有成长为真正实在的实体的那种规定的方式。
事情本身在这种对实体的直接意识中具有单纯本质的形式，这种本质作为普遍的东西把它的所有不同环节都包含在自身内并属于它们，但又同样对它们作为有规定的环节漠不关心，并且自为地是自由的，而且作为这种自由的、单纯的、抽象的事情本身，作为本质而有效。
原初规定性的各种环节、或者说这一个体的事情的各种环节——它的目的、手段、行动本身以及现实性——，对这种意识来说，一方面是一些个别的环节，意识可以相对于事情本身而离开并放弃它们；但另一方面，它们全都只是这样把事情本身当作本质：事情本身作为它们的抽象普遍的东西，出现在这些不同环节的每一个上面，并且能够成为它们的谓词。
它本身还不是主体，那些环节反而充当主体，因为它们落在一般个别性那一侧，而事情本身却还只是单纯普遍的东西。
它是这样一个类，它在所有这些环节中作为它们的种而发现自己，并且同样不受它们约束。

en: Consciousness is called honest which, on the one hand, has come to this idealism that the matter itself expresses, and, on the other hand, has the true in it as this formal universality; which is always concerned only with it, and therefore roams about in its various moments or species, and, in that it does not reach it in one of them or in one meaning, precisely thereby gets hold of it in another of them, and thus in fact always wins the satisfaction that this consciousness, according to its concept, was to receive.
Let it go as it will, it has accomplished and reached the matter itself, for as this universal genus of those moments it is the predicate of all.
zh: 那种意识被称为诚实的：它一方面达到了事情本身所表达的这种观念论，另一方面又在事情本身那里、作为这种形式上的普遍性而拥有真的东西；它总是只关涉到事情本身，因此就在它的各种环节或各个种类里转来转去，而由于它在一个环节里或一种含义上没有达到事情本身，它恰恰因此就在另一个环节上抓住了事情本身，于是事实上总是获得那种按它的概念本来应当归于这种意识的满足。
不管它怎样进行，它都已经完成并达到了事情本身，因为事情本身作为那些环节的这个普遍的类，是一切东西的谓词。

en: If it does not bring a purpose to actuality, it has nevertheless willed it; that is, it makes the purpose as purpose, the pure doing that does nothing, into the matter itself, and can therefore express itself and console itself by saying that after all something has always been done and busied about.

Since the universal itself contains the negative, or vanishing, under itself, this too — that the work destroys itself — is itself its doing; it has provoked the others to it, and in the vanishing of its actuality it still finds satisfaction, just as naughty boys enjoy themselves in the box on the ear they receive, namely as its cause.

Or it has not even attempted to carry out the matter itself and has done nothing at all, then it has not been able to; the matter itself is for it precisely the unity of its resolve and of reality, it asserts that actuality would be nothing other than its being able.

– Finally, if something interesting to it has come about altogether without its doing, then this actuality is for it the matter itself precisely in the interest it takes in it, although it has not been brought forth by it; if it is a piece of good fortune that has befallen it personally, it holds to it as to its deed and its merit –; if it is otherwise a world-event that does not concern it at all, it likewise makes it its own, and deedless interest counts for it as the party it has taken for or against and has fought for or upheld.
zh: 如果它没有把一个目的带向现实性，那它毕竟还是意欲过这个目的，也就是说，它把目的作为目的、把那个什么都不做的纯粹行动，当成了事情本身，因此可以这样表述自己并这样安慰自己：毕竟总还是做了什么、忙了什么。
既然普遍的东西本身把否定者或消失者包含在自身之下，那么作品毁灭自身这件事，也同样是它自己的行动；它曾为此挑动了别人，并且在它的现实性消失时还找到满足，就像顽皮的男孩在挨到的那记耳光里享受自己，也就是把自己当作这记耳光的原因来享受。
或者它连实行事情本身都不曾尝试过、干脆什么都没做，那么它就是没有能够；事情本身对它来说恰恰就是它的决意与实在性的统一，它断言现实性不是别的，正是它的能力。
——最后，如果有某件对它来说有趣的事情根本没有它插手就成了现实，那么这种现实性在它看来恰恰就是事情本身，就在它对之怀有的那种兴趣之中，尽管这件事并不是由它产生出来的；如果这是一桩它亲身遇到的幸事，那它就把这当作自己的行动和功劳——；如果这另外是一桩与它毫不相干的世界事件，那它同样把它变成自己的事情，而并不付诸行动的关心在它看来就等于它曾赞成或反对、并为之斗争或加以维护的那个党派。

en: The honesty of this consciousness, as well as the satisfaction it experiences everywhere, consists, as is evident, in the fact that it does not bring together its thoughts, which it has about the matter itself.

The matter itself is for it just as much its own affair as it is no work at all, or the pure doing and the empty purpose, or else a deedless actuality; it makes one meaning after another into the subject of this predicate and forgets one after the other.
Now, in mere having-willed, or also in not having been able, the matter itself has the meaning of the empty purpose and of the thought unity of willing and accomplishing.

The consolation over the destruction of the purpose — that it was nevertheless willed, or at least purely done — as well as the satisfaction of having given the others something to do, makes the pure doing, or the altogether bad work, into the essence; for that is to be called a bad one which is no work at all.
Finally, in the lucky case of finding actuality already there, this being without deed becomes the matter itself.
zh: 这种意识的诚实，以及它在各处经验到的满足，正如已经显明的那样，实际上就在于：它并不把它关于事情本身所具有的那些想法拢到一起。
事情本身在它看来既是它自己的事情，又根本不是任何作品，或者说，既是纯粹的行动和空洞的目的，又是一种不付诸行动的现实性；它把一种含义接着另一种含义地弄成这个谓词的主体，又把它们一个接一个地忘掉。
这时，在单纯意欲过、或者也没能够的情况下，事情本身所具有的含义就是空洞的目的，以及意愿与完成之被想到的统一。
从目的的毁灭中得到的安慰——毕竟意欲过，或者毕竟纯粹地行动过——，以及让别的人有事可做的满足，把纯粹的行动、或者那件完全糟糕的作品弄成了本质；因为那种根本不成其为作品的东西，才该叫作糟糕的作品。
最后，在碰巧遇到现成现实性这种幸运情况下，这种没有行动的存在就变成了事情本身。

en: But the truth of this honesty is that it is not as honest as it looks.

For it cannot be so thoughtless as to let these different moments actually fall apart in this way; rather, it must have the immediate consciousness of their opposition, because they relate themselves absolutely to one another.
Pure doing is essentially the doing of this individual, and this doing is just as essentially an actuality or a matter.
Conversely, actuality is essentially only as its doing as well as doing in general; and its doing is at the same time, just as doing in general, also actuality.
Thus, while it seems to be concerned only with the matter itself as abstract actuality, this too is present, that it is concerned with it as its own doing.
But just as much, while it is concerned only with doing and busying itself, it is thereby not in earnest, but is concerned with a matter and with the matter as its own.
Finally, while it seems to will only its own affair and its own doing, it is again concerned with the matter in general, or with the actuality that persists in and for itself.
zh: 不过，这种诚实的真理却是：它并不像它看起来那样诚实。
因为它不可能如此没有思想，竟让这些不同的环节在事实上就这样四分五裂，相反，它必定具有关于它们的对立的直接意识，因为它们绝对地相互关联。
纯粹的行动在本质上就是这个个体的行动，而这种行动同样在本质上是一种现实性或者一件事情。
反过来，现实性在本质上只是作为它的行动、以及作为一般的行动；而它的行动同时既像一般的行动，也同样地是现实性。
所以，当它看来只关涉到作为抽象现实性的事情本身时，这一点也同样存在：它关涉到的是作为它自己行动的事情本身。
但同样，当它只关涉到行动和奔忙时，它这样一来就不是认真的，而是关涉到一件事情，并且是关涉到这件事情作为它自己的事情。
最后，当它看来只意愿它自己的事情和它自己的行动时，它关涉到的又是普遍的事情，或者说，是那种自在自为地持存着的现实性。

en: Just as the matter itself and its moments appear here as content, they are just as necessarily also present as forms on consciousness.
They come on the scene as content only in order to vanish, and each makes way for the other.
They must therefore be present in the determinacy, as sublated; but thus they are sides of consciousness itself.

The matter itself is present as the in-itself, or its reflection into itself; but the displacement of the moments by one another expresses itself on it in such a way that they are posited on it not in themselves, but only for an other.

One of the moments of the content is by it exposed to the day and represented for others; but consciousness is at the same time reflected out of this into itself, and the opposite is likewise present in it; it keeps it for itself as its own.

At the same time, it is also not any one of them that would alone be put outside while another would be kept only within, but consciousness alternates between them; for it must make the one as well as the other into what is essential for itself and for the others.

The whole is the self-moving interpenetration of individuality and of the universal; but because this whole is present for this consciousness only as the simple essence and thus as the abstraction of the matter itself, its moments fall outside it and apart as separated; and as a whole it is exhausted and presented only through the separating alternation of exhibiting and of keeping for oneself.

While in this alternation consciousness has one moment for itself and as essential in its reflection, but another only externally on it or for the others, there thus enters a play of individualities with one another, in which they as much deceive themselves as find themselves mutually deceived.
zh: 正如事情本身及其诸环节在这里作为内容出现，它们也同样必然地作为形式出现在意识那里。
它们作为内容出场，只是为了消失，而每一个都为另一个让出位置。
因此它们必定在规定性中、作为被扬弃的而存在着；但这样一来，它们就是意识本身的各个面。
事情本身是作为自在、或者作为它向自身内的反思而存在着的；但诸环节相互之间的排挤，在它那里却这样表现出来：它们不是在它那里自在地、而只是为一个他者而被设定。
内容的诸环节中的一个，被它摆到白昼之下，并为他人而成为被表象的东西；但意识同时由此而反思到自身内，那个相反的东西也同样在它之中存在着；它把后者为自己保留下来，当作它自己的东西。
同时，也并不是其中某一个环节单独被摆到外面，而另一个则只被保留在内部，相反，意识是在它们之间交替变换的；因为它必须把两者中的每一个都弄成对它自己和对别人来说本质性的东西。
整体是个体性与普遍的东西之自身运动着的相互渗透；但因为对这个意识来说，这个整体只作为简单的本质、并由此只作为事情本身的抽象而存在着，所以它的诸环节就作为分离的环节落在它之外并彼此分开；而作为整体，它只有通过陈列与为自己保留这种分离着的交替才被穷尽并呈现出来。
在这种交替中，意识把一个环节自为地、并且作为本质性的环节而拥有在它的反思中，而另一个环节则只是外在地在它那里、或者为着别人而被它拥有，于是诸个体性之间就出现了一种游戏，在这种游戏里，它们既欺骗自己，又发现彼此受了欺骗。

en: An individuality therefore sets out to carry out something; it thereby seems to have made something into the matter; it acts, becomes therein something for others, and it seems to be concerned with actuality.
The others therefore take its doing as an interest in the matter as such and as the purpose that the matter be carried out in itself, indifferent whether by the first individuality or by them.

While, accordingly, they point out this matter as already brought about by them, or, if not, offer and lend their help, that consciousness is rather out of the place where they think it is; it is its doing and busying that interests it in the matter, and in becoming aware that this was the matter itself, they find themselves deceived.

– But in fact their rushing up to help was itself nothing other than that they wanted to see and show their doing, not the matter itself; that is, they wanted to deceive the others in precisely the way they complain of having been deceived.

– Since it has now come out that one's own doing and busying, the play of one's forces, counts as the matter itself, consciousness seems to carry on its essence for itself and not for the others, and, concerned only with the doing as its own, not with it as a doing of the others, thereby to let the others likewise have their way in their matter.
But they are mistaken again; it has already come out from where they thought it was.
It is not concerned with the matter as this single matter of its own, but is concerned with it as matter, as the universal that is for all.

It therefore mixes itself into their doing and work, and if it can no longer take the same out of their hands, it at least takes an interest in it through this, that it makes itself busy with it by judging; if it presses on it the stamp of its approval and its praise, this is meant in such a way that it praises on the work not only the work itself, but at the same time its own magnanimity and moderation, in not having spoiled the work as work and also not through its censure.

In showing an interest in the work, it enjoys itself therein; likewise the work that is censured by it is welcome to it for precisely this enjoyment of its own doing, which is thereby procured for it.
But those who hold or give themselves out as deceived by this interference wanted rather themselves to deceive in the same way.
They give out their doing and busying as something that is only for themselves, in which they aimed only at themselves and their own essence.

But in that they do something and thereby exhibit themselves and show themselves to the day, they immediately contradict by the deed their pretence of wanting to exclude the day itself, the universal consciousness and the participation of all; the actualization is rather an exhibition of what is one's own into the universal element, whereby it becomes and is to become the matter of all.
zh: 所以，一个个体性出马去实行某事；它由此看来已经把某件事弄成了正事；它行动着，在其中成为为着别人的东西，而它看来关涉到的正是现实性。
所以，别的人把它的这种行动看作对事情本身的兴趣，并且看作这样一个目的：事情自在地得到实行，无论这是由第一个个体性还是由他们来做，都无所谓。
当他们据此指出这件事情已经由他们做成了，或者在做不到时提供并给予他们的帮助，那么那个意识反倒已经从他们以为它在的地方走了出来；它在事情那里感兴趣的其实是它的行动和奔忙，而当他们觉察到这原来就是事情本身时，他们便发现自己受了骗。
——但实际上，他们赶来帮忙这件事本身，不是别的，正是他们想看、想显示的是他们自己的行动，而不是事情本身；也就是说，他们想用他们抱怨自己受了骗的那种方式去欺骗别人。
——既然现在已经暴露出：它自己的行动和奔忙、它的各种力的游戏，算作事情本身，那么意识看来就是在为它自己、而不是为别人操持它的本质，并且只操心那种作为它自己的行动、而不操心那种作为别人行动的行动，因此也就让别的人在他们的事情里各行其是。
可是他们又弄错了；它早已从他们以为它在的地方走了出来。
它关涉到的并不是作为它这个单个事情的事情，而是关涉到它作为事情、作为对所有人都存在的普遍东西。
所以它插手到他们的行动和作品里去，而如果它已经不能再把作品从他们手里拿走，它至少通过这一点而对之发生兴趣：它通过评判使自己插手其中；如果它给作品打上自己赞同和赞扬的印记，那么这意思就是：它在作品上不仅赞扬作品本身，而且同时赞扬它自己的宽宏和节制——它没有把作品作为作品毁掉，也没有通过它的责备把作品毁掉。
当它对作品表现出兴趣时，它就在其中享受自己；同样，那件受到它责备的作品，也正因为它由此获得的对自己行动的享受而受到它的欢迎。
可是，那些由于这种插手而自认为受了骗、或者声称自己受了骗的人，反倒是自己也想用同样的方式去骗人。
他们把自己的行动和奔忙说成是某种只为他们自己而存在的东西，说成是他们在其中只以自己和自己的本质为目的的东西。
可是，既然他们做了某事，并由此把自己摆出来、把自己显示给白昼，他们就用行动直接反驳了他们那个声称：他们想要把白昼本身、把普遍的意识和所有人的参与都排除在外；现实化反倒是一种把自己特有的东西摆到普遍要素中去的陈列，它由此成为、并且应当成为所有人的事情。

en: It is therefore equally a deception of itself and of the others if it is supposed to be a matter only of the pure matter; a consciousness that opens up a matter rather makes the experience that the others, like flies to freshly set-out milk, come hurrying up and want to know themselves busy at it, – and they make it on it, that for it too it is not a matter of the matter as object, but of its own.

On the other hand, if only the doing itself, the use of forces and capacities, or the utterance of this individuality is supposed to be what is essential, then the experience is likewise made reciprocally that everyone stirs himself and takes himself for invited, and that instead of a pure doing or a single peculiar doing, rather something that is equally for others, or a matter itself, has been opened up.
In both cases the same happens, and it has only a different sense as against that which was assumed in the process and was supposed to hold.

Consciousness experiences both sides as equally essential moments and, in this, what the nature of the matter itself is, namely neither merely a matter that would be opposed to doing in general and to the individual doing, nor a doing that would be opposed to subsistence and would be the genus free from these moments as its species, but an essence whose being is the doing of the individual individual and of all individuals, and whose doing is immediately for others or a matter, and is only matter as the doing of all and each, the essence that is the essence of all essences, the spiritual essence.

Consciousness experiences that none of those moments is subject, but rather dissolves into the universal matter itself; the moments of individuality, which in the thoughtlessness of this consciousness successively counted as subject, gather themselves together into the simple individuality, which as this one is likewise immediately universal.

The matter itself thereby loses the relation of the predicate and the determinacy of lifeless abstract universality; it is rather the substance pervaded by individuality; the subject in which individuality is equally as itself or as this one as also as all individuals, and the universal, which only as this doing of all and each is a being, an actuality in that this consciousness knows it as its single actuality and as the actuality of all.

The pure matter itself is what determined itself above as the category: the being that is I, or I that is being, but as thinking, which still distinguishes itself from actual self-consciousness; here, however, they are the moments of actual self-consciousness, insofar as we call them its content, purpose, doing and actuality, as also insofar as we call them its form.
Being-for-itself and being-for-another, posited as one with the simple category itself, and it is thereby at the same time all content.
zh: 所以，如果事情只应当在于纯粹的事情，那它同样是对自己和对他人的欺骗；一个把事情摊开来的意识，反倒会经验到：别人就像苍蝇扑向刚摆出来的牛奶一样赶过来，并且想借此知道自己是在忙碌的，——而他们则在这个意识身上经验到，它同样不是要关心作为对象的事情，而是要关心属于它自己的事情。
反之，如果只应当以行动本身、以使用各种力和能力、或者以说出这种个体性为要紧的东西，那么同样会相互地得到这样的经验：所有人都在动，都认为自己受到了邀请，而且被摊开来的不是一种纯粹的行动或一种个别的、特有的行动，而毋宁是某种同样为他人存在的东西，或者是一个事情本身。
在两种情况下发生的都是同一件事，它只是相对于那个在此被假定、并且本应有效的东西才有不同的意义。
意识把双方都经验为同样本质的环节，并且在这里经验到事情本身的本性是什么，即它既不只是事情，这事情会与一般的行动和个别的行动相对立，也不是行动，这行动会与持存相对立，并且会是那个摆脱了这些作为它的种的环节的属，而是一个本质，它的存在就是个别个体和一切个体的行动，它的行动直接地就是为他人或为一个事情，并且只有作为所有人、每个人的行动才是事情，这个本质就是一切本质的本质，就是精神的本质。
意识经验到，那些环节没有一个会是主体，反倒是消融在普遍的事情本身之中；个体性的那些环节，在这个意识的无思想性中曾先后被当作主体，凝聚成简单的个体性，而它作为这一个同样是直接普遍的。
事情本身由此失去了谓词的关系和无生命的抽象普遍性的规定性，它毋宁是被个体性渗透的实体；这个主体，在其中个体性同样既是它自己或这一个，又是一切个体，还有这个普遍的东西，它只有作为所有人、每个人的这一行动才是一种存在，一种现实性，因为这个意识把它既知为它自己的单个现实性，又知为所有人的现实性。
纯粹的事情本身，就是上面把自己规定为范畴的那个东西：存在，它就是我，或者我，它就是存在，但作为思维，这思维还区别于现实的自我意识；但在这里，它们是现实自我意识的环节，既就我们把它们称为它的内容、目的、行动和现实性而言，也就我们把它们称为它的形式而言。
自为存在和为他存在，与简单的范畴本身被设定为一，而它由此同时就是一切内容。

en: The spiritual essence is in its simple being pure consciousness and this self-consciousness.

The originally determinate nature of the individual has lost its positive significance of being in itself the element and the purpose of its activity; it is only a sublated moment, and the individual a self, as universal self.

Conversely, the formal matter itself has its fulfilment in the acting individuality that distinguishes itself within itself; for the differences of this individuality make up the content of that universal.
The category is in itself, as the universal of pure consciousness; it is likewise for itself, for the self of consciousness is likewise its moment.
It is absolute being, for that universality is the simple self-equality of being.
zh: 精神的本质在它的简单存在中就是纯粹意识，并且就是这种自我意识。
个体那原初被规定的本性，已经失去了它积极的意义，即自在地是它活动的要素和目的；它只是一个被扬弃的环节，而个体则是一个自我，作为普遍的自我。
反过来，形式的事情本身在行动着的、在自身内区分自己的个体性那里得到了充实；因为这个个体性的种种差别构成了那个普遍东西的内容。
范畴是自在的，作为纯粹意识的普遍东西；它同样也是自为的，因为意识的自我同样是它的环节。
它是绝对存在，因为那种普遍性就是存在的那种简单的自身等同。

en: What is thus object for consciousness has the significance of being the true; it is and holds in the sense of being and holding in and for itself; it is the absolute matter, which no longer suffers from the opposition of certainty and its truth, of the universal and the singular, of purpose and its reality, but whose determinate being is the actuality and the doing of self-consciousness; this matter is therefore the ethical substance, the consciousness of it ethical consciousness.

Its object counts for it likewise as the true, for it unites self-consciousness and being in a unity; it counts as the absolute, for self-consciousness can and will no longer go beyond this object, for it is therein with itself: it cannot, for he is all being and power, – it will not, for he is the self or the will of this self.
It is the real object in itself as object, for it has the difference of consciousness on it; it divides itself into masses, which are the determinate laws of the absolute essence.

But these masses do not cloud the concept, for in it the moments of being and of pure consciousness and of the self remain enclosed, – a unity which constitutes the essence of these masses and in this difference no longer lets these moments step apart.
zh: 所以，对意识来说行动对象的东西，其意义就是它是真的东西；它存在并且有效，意思就是它自在自为地存在并且有效；它是绝对的事情，这事情不再受确定性与它的真理、普遍的东西与个别的东西、目的与它的实在性之间对立的折磨，相反，它的定在就是自我意识的现实性和行动；所以，这事情就是伦理的实体，而对它的意识就是伦理的意识。
它的对象在它看来同样有效为真的东西，因为它把自我意识和存在统一在一个统一体中；这对象有效为绝对的东西，因为自我意识不能再也不愿再越出这个对象，因为它在其中就是在自己那里：它不能，因为这对象就是一切存在和威力，——它不愿，因为这对象就是自我，或者就是这自我的意志。
它是那个在它自身那里作为对象的实在对象，因为它在自身那里带有意识的差别；它把自己分成许多块体，而这些块体就是绝对本质的那些特定法则。
但这些块体并不把概念搅浑，因为在概念中，存在、纯粹意识和自我的那些环节始终被包含在内，——这是一个统一体，它构成这些块体的本质，并且在这种差别中不再让这些环节彼此分开。

en: These laws or masses of the ethical substance are immediately recognized; it cannot be asked after their origin and legitimacy, nor can an other be sought, for an other than the essence that is in and for itself would be only self-consciousness itself; but it is nothing other than this essence, for it itself is the being-for-itself of this essence, which is the truth precisely because it is just as much the self of consciousness as its in-itself or pure consciousness.
zh: 伦理实体的这些法则或块体是直接被承认的；不能追问它们的起源和正当性，也不能去寻找一个他者，因为，一个不同于自在自为地存在着的本质的他者，只会是自我意识本身；但自我意识不是别的，就是这个本质，因为它自己就是这一本质的自为存在，而这个本质之所以是真理，正因为它是意识的自我，也同样是它的自在或纯粹意识。

en: In that self-consciousness knows itself as moment of the being-for-itself of this substance, it thus expresses the determinate being of the law in it in such a way that sound reason immediately knows what is right and good.
As immediately as it knows it, so immediately does it also count for it, and it says immediately: this is right and good.
And indeed the latter; they are determinate laws, it is fulfilled, content-full matter itself.
zh: 由于自我意识知道自己就是这一实体的自为存在的环节，所以它就把法则在它之中的定在表达成这样：健全的理性直接知道什么是正当的、什么是善的。
理性多么直接地知道这一点，这一点对理性也就多么直接地有效，并且理性直接地说：这是正当的、善的。
而且正是这些；它们是特定的法则，它是充实而有内容的事情本身。

en: What gives itself thus immediately must likewise be taken up and considered immediately; just as with what sense-certainty immediately pronounces as existing, so too with the being that this ethical immediate certainty pronounces, or with the immediately existing masses of the ethical essence, it is to be seen how they are constituted.

The examples of some such laws will show this, and in taking them in the form of pronouncements of knowing sound reason, we do not first have to bring along the moment which, when they are considered as immediate ethical laws, is to be made valid in them.
zh: 这样直接地给出自己的东西，也必须同样直接地被接纳和考察；正如对于感性确定性直接说成存在的东西那样，对于这种伦理的直接确定性所说出的存在，或者对于伦理本质的那些直接存在着的块体，也要看一看它们是怎么构成的。
一些这样的法则的例子会表明这一点，而当我们把它们取作有知识的健全理性的种种说法时，我们就不必先把那个环节带过来，这个环节在它们被看作直接的伦理法则时，是要在它们身上发挥效力的。

en: »Everyone ought to speak the truth.«
– With this duty, pronounced as unconditional, the condition will at once be conceded: if he knows the truth.
The commandment will hereby now read thus: everyone ought to speak the truth, each time according to his knowledge and conviction of it.

Sound reason, precisely this ethical consciousness, which immediately knows what is right and good, will also explain that this condition was already so bound up with its universal utterance that it meant that commandment thus.

Thereby, however, it in fact admits that it had rather already immediately violated it in the pronouncing of it; it said: everyone ought to speak the truth; but it meant that he ought to speak it according to his knowledge and conviction of it; i.e. it spoke otherwise than it meant, and to speak otherwise than one means is not to speak the truth.
The improved untruth or ineptitude now expresses itself thus: everyone should speak the truth according to his respective knowledge and conviction of it.
– But thereby the universally necessary, that which holds in itself, which the proposition wanted to pronounce, has rather been transformed into a perfect contingency.

For that the truth is spoken is left to chance, whether I know it and can convince myself of it; and nothing further is said than that true and false are to be spoken mixed up together, as it happens that someone knows, means and comprehends it.

This contingency of the content has universality only in the form of a proposition, in which it is expressed; but as an ethical proposition it promises a universal and necessary content and thus contradicts itself through the contingency of that content.

– If finally the proposition is so improved that the contingency of knowledge and conviction of the truth should drop away and the truth should also be known, then this would be a commandment that directly contradicts what was started from.
Sound reason was first supposed to have immediately the capacity to pronounce the truth; but now it is said that it should know it, i.e. that it does not know how to pronounce it immediately.

– Considered from the side of content, it has dropped out in the demand that one should know the truth; for it relates to knowing in general: one should know; what is demanded is therefore rather that which is free of all determinate content.
But here there was talk of a determinate content, of a difference on the ethical substance.

But this immediate determination of it is such a content as rather showed itself to be a perfect contingency and, raised into universality and necessity, so that knowing is pronounced as the law, rather vanishes.
zh: “每个人都应当说真理。”
——对于这条被说成无条件的义务，马上就会承认一个条件：如果他知道真理。
这样一来，这条命令现在就应当这样说：每个人都应当说真理，每一次都按照他自己对真理的所知和确信。
健全的理性，也就是这种直接知道什么是正当和善的伦理意识，也会解释说，这一条件早就已经这样与它的普遍说法结合在一起，以致它当时所说的那条命令就是这个意思。
但这样一来，它其实就承认：它在说出这条命令时早就直接地违背了它；它说：每个人都应当说真理；但它意谓的却是，他应当按照自己对真理的所知和确信来说真理；也就是说，它说得和它所意谓的不一样，而说得和人所意谓的不一样，就叫不说真理。
经过改良的非真理或笨拙，现在就表达成这样：每个人都应当按照他每一次对真理的所知和确信来说真理。
——但这样一来，那个命题想要说出的、普遍必然的、自在地有效的东西，反倒变成了一种完全的偶然性。
因为真理是否被说出来，被交给了偶然：我是否知道它、能否对它确信；而所说的不外是：真的东西和假的东西应当混杂在一起被说出来，就看一个人是怎样认识、意谓和以概念把握它的。
这种内容上的偶然性，只在它被表达于其中的命题形式那里才具有普遍性；但作为伦理的命题，它许诺的是普遍必然的内容，并因此通过这内容的偶然性而与自己相矛盾。
——如果最后把这个命题改良成这样：关于真理的所知和确信的偶然性应当去掉，真理也应当被知道，那么这就会是一条命令，它直接与出发点的东西相矛盾。
健全的理性起初应当直接具有说出真理的能力；但现在却说，它应当知道真理，也就是说，它并不知道怎样直接说出真理。
——从内容方面来看，在“人应当知道真理”这一要求中，内容已经消失了；因为这要求涉及的是知识一般：人应当知道；所以被要求的东西毋宁是那种摆脱了一切特定内容的东西。
但这里谈的却是一个特定的内容，是伦理实体上的一个差别。
但这种对它的直接规定，却是这样一种内容：它反倒表明自己是一种完全的偶然性，并且当它被提升到普遍性和必然性中、以致知识被说成法则时，它反倒消失了。

en: Another famous commandment is: love your neighbour as yourself.
It is directed at the individual in his relation to individuals, and asserts it as a relation of the individual to the individual, or as a relation of feeling.
Active love — for an inactive love has no being and is therefore presumably not what is meant — aims at separating ills from a human being and at adding good to him.

For this purpose it must be distinguished what in him is the ill, what against this ill is the appropriate good, and what in general is his welfare; i.e. I must love him with understanding; ununderstanding love will harm him, perhaps more than hatred.

But the understanding, essential beneficence is, in its richest and most important shape, the understanding, universal action of the state — an action compared with which the action of the individual as an individual becomes something altogether so trifling that it is almost not worth the trouble to speak of it.

That action is moreover of such great power that, if the individual action were to set itself against it and either be directly, for itself, a crime or, for the sake of another, want to cheat the universal of the right and the share which it has in it, it would be altogether useless and would be irresistibly destroyed.
There remains to beneficence, which is feeling, only the significance of a wholly individual action, of an emergency assistance that is as contingent as it is momentary.
Contingency determines not only its occasion but also whether it is a work at all, whether it is not at once dissolved again and itself rather converted into ill.

This acting, then, for the welfare of others, which is pronounced to be necessary, is so constituted that it perhaps can exist, perhaps also not; that, if the case presents itself by chance, it is perhaps a work, perhaps good, perhaps also not.
This law therefore has just as little a universal content as the first one that was considered, and, as it as an absolute ethical law should, it does not express something that is in and for itself.
Or such laws remain merely with the ought, but have no actuality; they are not laws but only commandments.
zh: 另一条著名的诫命是：爱你的邻人如同爱你自己。
它是针对处在与各个个人的关系中的个人而说的，并且把它主张为个人对个人的关系，或者说成感受的关系。
行动着的爱——因为不行动的爱没有存在，所以大概并不是这里所说的意思——所指向的是把祸患从一个人身上祛除，并给他善。
为了这个目的，就必须区分：在他身上什么是祸患，针对这祸患什么是合目的的善，以及一般说来什么是他的福祉；也就是说，我必须带着知性去爱他；没有知性的爱会害了他，也许比恨还厉害。
但有知性的、本质的善行，在它最丰富、最重要的形态中，就是国家有知性的普遍行动——与这种行动相比，个人作为个人的行动就成了一种如此微不足道的东西，以至于几乎不值得去谈它。
那种行动在这里有如此大的力量，以至于如果单个的行动想要与它对抗，要么直接自为地就是罪行，要么为了别人而欺骗普遍东西，把它在单个行动那里拥有的权利和份额骗走，那么它就会完全无用，并且会被不可抗拒地摧毁。
对作为感受的善行来说，剩下的只是一种完全单个的行动、一种应急救助的意义，而这种救助既偶然又转瞬即逝。
偶然性不仅决定它的时机，而且决定它究竟是不是一件作品，决定它是不是马上又会被消解、本身反而转化为祸患。
所以，这种为他人福祉的行动，虽然被说成是必然的，却是这样：它也许能存在，也许不能；如果情况偶然出现，它也许是一件作品，也许是好的，也许也不是。
因此这条法则和前面考察过的第一条法则一样，也没有普遍的内容，并且并不像它作为绝对伦理法则应该做的那样，表达出某种自在自为地存在的东西。
或者，这类法则只停留在应当上，却没有现实性；它们不是法则，而只是诫命。

en: But it is evident in fact from the nature of the matter itself that a universal absolute content must be renounced; for to the simple substance — and its essence is this, to be simple — every determinacy that is posited in it is inadequate.

The commandment in its simple absoluteness itself expresses immediate ethical being; the difference that appears in it is a determinacy and thus a content that stands under the absolute universality of this simple being.

Since accordingly an absolute content must be renounced, only formal universality, or this, that it does not contradict itself, can belong to it; for contentless universality is the formal one, and absolute content itself means as much as a difference that is none, or as contentlessness.
zh: 但从事情本身的本性中可以清楚地看出，必须放弃一种普遍的绝对内容；因为对简单的实体——它的本质就在于它是简单的——来说，任何被设定在它上面的规定性都是不相称的。
诫命在它简单的绝对性中，本身就说出直接的伦理存在；在它身上出现的差别是一种规定性，因而是一种内容，这种内容处于这种简单存在的绝对普遍性之下。
由于这样一来就必须放弃一种绝对内容，能够属于它的就只有形式上的普遍性，或者说就只有这一点：它不自相矛盾；因为无内容的普遍性就是形式上的普遍性，而绝对内容本身的意思就等于一种并非差别的差别，或者说等于无内容性。

en: What remains to law-giving is therefore the pure form of universality, or in fact the tautology of consciousness, which steps over against the content and is a knowing, not of the existing or proper content, but of the essence or the self-equality of the same.
zh: 所以，留给立法的就是普遍性的纯粹形式，或者实际上就是意识的同语反复，这种同语反复与内容相对而立，并且是一种知识，它不是关于存在着的或本己的内容，而是关于这一内容的本质或自身等同性的。

en: The ethical essence is accordingly not immediately itself a content, but only a standard as to whether a content is capable of being law or not, in that it does not contradict itself.
Law-giving reason is reduced to a merely testing reason.
zh: 因此，伦理本质并不是直接地本身就是一种内容，而只是一个尺度，看一种内容是否能够成为法则，即看它是否不自相矛盾。
立法的理性被降格为一种仅仅审查的理性。
